comment: Local plugins that exist under Plugins/ on a developer machine but are not
tracked by this repository. A clean clone does not have them, so anything
they add to a build makes that build unreproducible. Scripts/Test-CigLocalPlugins.ps1
reads this file and fails when an untracked plugin can still reach the packaged game.
Names only. No absolute paths, no user names, no install directories: this file is
read on every machine and in CI, where none of those exist.

localPlugins.name: Sentry
localPlugins.reason: Crash reporting was evaluated, not adopted. It is present only because the plugin was installed into Plugins/ locally, and .gitignore keeps it out of the repository. Adoption needs its own reviewed feature: a DSN, a consent decision and CRASH_PRIVACY.md all have to change together.
